features.feature_value: Direct dehumanizing/derogatory insults aimed at a political party
features.evidence_span: "Democrats are spineless cowards. All they can do is wail and cry in the corner."
features.rationale: Uses strong derogatory labeling and mocking behavior claims about an opposing political group.

features.feature_value: US-vs-them framing via opponent vs opponent (Democrats vs Democrats counterpart in mirror)
features.rationale: Blame/praise is directed at an entire political party rather than an individual or policy detail.

features.feature_value: Claims laws are selectively enforced to deny rights to a racial group
features.evidence_span: "gun laws selectively enforced against almost exclusively minorities"
features.rationale: Explicit discrimination/victimhood mechanism is asserted, linking enforcement to racial oppression.

features.feature_value: Gun laws + rights denial/equal rights discussion
features.rationale: Primary topic is firearms regulation framed as impacting constitutional/rights outcomes.

features.feature_value: Causal claim about hollowing out due to manufacturing moving + hiring foreigners
features.evidence_span: "The Rust Belt hollowed out when manufacturing moved to Asia."
features.rationale: States a direct causal explanation for economic decline tied to labor/offshoring.

features.feature_value: Blame directed to corporations/greed as an agent
features.rationale: Attributes negative outcomes to a powerful corporate actor/class, not to neutral factors.
Contains explicit sexual taboo language used to demean a political stance.

features.feature_value: If-then structure about a hypothetical test of support
features.evidence_span: "If Trump got the same tattoo tomorrow fully knowing what it was his support would drop"
features.rationale: Uses conditional logic to predict political support change under a specific scenario.
